Advertisement Notice
Applications are invited for the appointment of (01) Guest Faculty to teach the subject
of Information Technology at UIET, Panjab University Swami Sarvanand Giri
Regional Centre, Bajwara, Hoshiarpur for the Odd Semester, Academic session 2026-
27.
The applicants are required to fill the application form for the Assistant Professors available
on the Panjab University Website as per link given below:
https://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20200122155429directrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplic
ationformasperugcregulation2018.pdf (Pages 1-10).
The candidates should attach the attested copies of their certificates and other relevant
documents along with duly filled application form (05 Sets).
The applications complete in all respect should reach in office of
the Director, Panjab University Swami Sarvanand Giri Regional Centre, Una Road, ,
Bajwara, Hoshiarpur-146021 through Speed Post/Registered Post/By Hand upto
22-09-2026 (Up to 11:00 a.m.) . The application may also be submitted on official
e-mail id i.e. directorhsp@pu.ac.in in pdf format till above said date & time.
 Note: If applicant is submitting application through e-mail, he\she must have to
bring 05 sets in hard copy format at the time of interview.
Essential Qualification for Guest Faculty in Information Technology:
 Bachelor in Engineering/Technology degree in first class division (or an equivalent grade
on a point scale wherever the grading system is followed) in Information
Technology/Computer Science/Computer Science & Engineering or equivalent from an
Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university.
 Master in Engineering/Technology degree in first class division (or an equivalent grade
on a point scale wherever the grading system is followed) in Information
Technology/Computer Science/Computer Science & Engineering or equivalent from an
Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university.
M.E./M.Tech. with specialization in any of the fields of Information
Technology/Computer Science/Computer Science & Engineering are also eligible to
apply.
Note:
A relaxation of 5% shall be allowed at the Bachelor's as well as at the Master's level for the
candidates belonging to Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe.
Without prejudice to the above, the following conditions may be considered as desirable:
Ph.D. degree in a relevant subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from
an accredited foreign University, in accordance with the University Grants Commission
(Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of Ph.D. Degree) Regulations, 2009 or 2016
and their amendments from time to time as the case may be provided further, candidates
registered for the Ph.D. programme prior to July 11, 2009, shall be governed by the
provisions of the then-existing Ordinances/Bye-laws/Regulations of the Institutions
awarding the degree and such Ph.D. candidates shall be considered for appointment of
Assistant Professor subject to the fulfillment of the following conditions:
A) Ph.D. degree of the candidate awarded in regular mode only;
B) Evaluation of Ph.D. thesis by at least two external examiners;
C) An open Ph.D. viva voce of the candidate has been conducted;
D) Candidate has published two research papers from his/her Ph.D. work out of which at
least one must be in refereed journal;
E) Candidate has made at least two presentations in conferences/seminars, based on his/her
Ph.D. work.
(A) to (E) as above are to be certified by the Registrar/Dean (Academic Affairs).
Papers published in refereed/UGC Care list of journals.
Teaching/research, industrial and/or professional experience in reputed organisation.
The fulfilment of these conditions is to be certified by the Registrar or the Dean (Academic
Affairs) of the University concerned.
The above assignment is on lecture basis with an honorarium of Rs. 1500/- per lecture with
an upper limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month.
The eligible candidates will be informed for attending interview telephonically and through
email.
No T.A. /D.A. will be paid for attending interview.
Sd/-
Director
